activities.name: Get
activities.whenToUse: Choose the Get-labeled REST activity for retrieval. The core reads Plan.Config.Method for the actual verb and may use local fallbacks; set Method to Get when GET behavior is required, especially for TargetPath output.

properties.description: Check whether configuration exists before inspecting TargetPath presence.
properties.whenToUse: Supply a Config object when using request options or TargetPath; the core checks Config presence before testing TargetPath. Omit only when no Config-based option is needed.

properties.description: Use a caller-supplied bearer token only when initial automatic token resolution was skipped.
properties.whenToUse: Supply a caller bearer token when Config.SkipBearerToken is true and initial automatic lookup is bypassed. If lookup is attempted but fails or returns empty, the wrapper stops before the core; a supplied token is not its failure fallback.

properties.description: Supply request content, serialized to JSON when needed.
properties.whenToUse: Supply request body content for the body branch; truthy non-string values are serialized to JSON before the request, while false or zero bypass that conversion. Omit for bodyless requests or GET TargetPath mode.

properties.description: Validate that target-file mode is a GET without status or request-body options.
properties.whenToUse: If TargetPath is supplied, leave Body absent. The core rejects target-file mode when a request body option is present, even for a Get-labeled activity.

properties.description: Supply the content type used with request body or source-file handling.
properties.whenToUse: Set the request content type when the body or source-file handling needs it. This is a Config option read by the REST core.

properties.description: Provide multipart form fields; file-valued fields are loaded from disk.
properties.whenToUse: Supply multipart form fields for the Form request branch; file-valued form fields are read from disk. Omit when using Body, SourcePath or target-file GET handling.

properties.description: Validate that target-file mode is a GET without status or request-body options.
properties.whenToUse: If TargetPath is supplied, leave Form absent. The core rejects target-file mode with any Form request option.

properties.description: Resolve inherited caller headers using the current local headers as fallback on a retry.
properties.whenToUse: On an authentication or host retry, configured headers are selected instead of the current local headers fallback; they are not merged by the resolver. A bearer token can subsequently overwrite Authorization in the selected headers.

properties.description: Resolve inherited caller headers with an empty-object fallback on the first request attempt.
properties.whenToUse: Supply initial caller headers when needed; the first core request resolves Config.Headers with an empty local header object fallback.

properties.description: Use caller-provided headers before considering generated storage headers.
properties.whenToUse: Supply caller headers before storage-specific headers are considered. The wrapper can generate storage headers and add them to a cloned Plan.

properties.description: Identify the token-cache host and bearer-token acquisition address.
properties.whenToUse: Supply the token-cache host and bearer-token acquisition address when automatic token resolution is used. Omit only when that path is skipped or not required.

properties.description: Choose the HTTP method; subsequent method-specific local fallbacks are not resolver defaults.
properties.whenToUse: Set the actual HTTP verb for the core request. Activity labels validate catalog choice but do not select the method; the core has branch-specific local fallbacks when Method is absent.

properties.description: Validate that target-file mode is a GET without status or request-body options.
properties.whenToUse: When using TargetPath, set Method to Get. The core validates actual Config.Method as Get regardless of the declared activity label.

properties.description: Append the configured query string when not already present in the URI.
properties.whenToUse: Supply a query-string suffix when it is not already present in Config.Uri. The core appends it to the resolved URI before calling the HTTP method.

properties.description: Choose whether the adapter returns the complete core result or only its Response.
properties.whenToUse: Set true when the wrapper should return the complete core result, including status metadata, rather than only Response. Omit or false for Response-only return.

properties.description: Request an HTTP status result for a bodyless request.
properties.whenToUse: For a bodyless request, set true when the core HTTP call should capture status and response headers. This is conditional on the request branch.

properties.description: Validate that target-file mode is a GET without status or request-body options.
properties.whenToUse: If TargetPath is supplied, leave ReturnHttpStatus false or absent. The core rejects target-file mode when status return is requested.

properties.description: Decide whether to resolve a fresh token after an authentication or host failure.
properties.whenToUse: On an authentication or host failure retry, set SkipBearerToken to avoid resolving a fresh token. Omit or false to allow retry token resolution.

properties.description: Skip initial bearer-token resolution when true.
properties.whenToUse: Set SkipBearerToken true to skip initial automatic bearer-token resolution. Omit or false to permit wrapper token lookup before the core call.

properties.description: Provide an input file path for the request.
properties.whenToUse: Supply a local input file for the source-file request branch when uploading content. The core reads this option from Config.SourcePath.

properties.description: Validate that target-file mode is a GET without status or request-body options.
properties.whenToUse: If TargetPath is supplied, leave SourcePath absent. The core rejects target-file mode when an input file is also configured.

properties.description: Validate the optional absolute output-file path for a GET response.
properties.whenToUse: Supply a nonempty absolute output-file path only for an actual GET request without ReturnHttpStatus, SourcePath, Body or Form. The core writes through a temporary path before the final target.

properties.description: Determine whether storage-specific headers should be generated.
properties.whenToUse: Supply the request URI so the wrapper can determine whether storage-specific headers apply. URI handling occurs before the cloned Plan reaches the core.

properties.description: Supply the request URI before query-string composition.
properties.whenToUse: Supply the request URI for the core request; Querystring may be appended if not already present. This address is used for the effectful HTTP call.

properties.description: Preserve the parent-phase reference while cloning.
properties.whenToUse: Retain an incoming parent-phase reference when Resolve-ClonePlan needs to preserve lineage before wrapper mutation; this is not a REST method selector.

properties.description: Preserve the parent-plan reference while cloning.
properties.whenToUse: Retain an incoming parent-plan reference when Resolve-ClonePlan preserves lineage before wrapper mutation; request behavior comes from Config fields.

result.description: When Config.Method selects actual HTTP method; activity name is validated but is not method selection; HTTP call returns and ReturnHttpStatus=false (Result presence conditional).
local target path [computed]. When Config.Method selects actual HTTP method; activity name is validated but is not method selection; Config.TargetPath download completes.
response body [provider-returned] (conditional). When Config.Method selects actual HTTP method; activity name is validated but is not method selection; HTTP call returns and ReturnHttpStatus=true.
final URL [computed]. When Config.Method selects actual HTTP method; activity name is validated but is not method selection; HTTP call returns and ReturnHttpStatus=true.
actual Config.Method [echoed-input]. When Config.Method selects actual HTTP method; activity name is validated but is not method selection; HTTP call returns and ReturnHttpStatus=true.
resolved resource [computed] (conditional). When Config.Method selects actual HTTP method; activity name is validated but is not method selection; HTTP call returns and ReturnHttpStatus=true.
constant true after HTTP invocation [constant]. When Config.Method selects actual HTTP method; activity name is validated but is not method selection; HTTP call returns and ReturnHttpStatus=true.
HTTP status including non-2xx [provider-returned]. When Config.Method selects actual HTTP method; activity name is validated but is not method selection; HTTP call returns and ReturnHttpStatus=true.
response headers [provider-returned] (conditional). When Config.Method selects actual HTTP method; activity name is validated but is not method selection; HTTP call returns and ReturnHttpStatus=true.
request stopwatch [measured]. When Config.Method selects actual HTTP method; activity name is validated but is not method selection; HTTP call returns and ReturnHttpStatus=true.
